title: A single pro-etale cover gives compatible bases of the abelian root diagram
statement: Let l be a prime, and let X be a scheme with l invertible in Gamma(X,O_X). Let T_n=rootsOfUnitySheaf X (l^n), the actual abelian sheafification of the presheaf of roots, with the lth-power transitions of [def-pur-condensed-tate-twists]. Let C_n be the constant abelian residue diagram constantTateResidueSystem X l of [lem-poincare-integral-residue-free-comparison]. There is a pro-etale cover (u_i:U_i->X) such that T composed with raw upperStar(u_i) is naturally isomorphic to C composed with raw upperStar(u_i) [def-sfb-finite-upper-star]. The diagrams include n=0. This is a statement of abelian sheaves only: it has no integral-module action, coefficient quotient, inverse limit, rational extension or constructibility conclusion.

proof.text: Cover X by affine opens and apply the closed source theorem exists_isWContractibleRing to each coordinate ring, as in [lem-weil-pbc-source-wcontractible-extension]. The spectrum maps are weakly etale, surjective and quasi-compact. Their singleton covers compose with the affine-open cover to give a Scheme.Cover indexed in Type u, without the universe lift in the previous covering-family route.

Over each w-contractible ring R, the source theorem exists_comp_eq_id_of_isWContractibleRing gives sections of surjective affine weakly etale maps, using the retraction property [lem-weil-pbc-existing-wcontractible-indetale-retraction]. Apply it to primitiveRootsCover R l, whose source construction is etale and surjective by the primitive-root argument [lem-sc-primitive-root] and the root-cover etaleness [lem-sbc-root-split-away-cover-etale]. Its distinguished root has all power differences invertible. Then apply the same section theorem recursively to R[T]/(T^l-a), etale and faithfully flat for every unit a. This constructs a compatible unit tower. In each field image, the first root is nontrivial and orderOf_eq_prime_pow makes the nth lift primitive of order l^(n+1). Thus its power differences avoid every maximal ideal and are units. These algebraic and geometric steps are fully proved in the private helpers of the delivered module.

Define exponentiation from the constant residue presheaf to the actual raw root presheaf using ZMod.lift. Unit power differences prove local injectivity: unequal residues with the same root force a unit to vanish, so the test scheme is empty. For local surjectivity apply the proved Lagrange polynomial identities to a root x; the basic opens for the products of x minus the other roots cover, and on each open x equals one chosen root. Hence the map is locally bijective and sheafification is an isomorphism. On natural-number representatives of every residue, the lth-power transitions agree by the compatible unit tower. NatTrans.ofOpSequence and componentwise isomorphism detection give a natural isomorphism from constant residues to roots, including the zero level.

For a weakly etale covering morphism, upperStarIsoLocalizationRestriction computes the actual inverse image by restriction; the closed source pushforwardContinuousSheafificationCompatibility commutes that restriction with sheafification. The raw roots and constants restrict definitionally to the corresponding diagrams on the cover scheme. Whisker these comparisons and compose with the inverse of the preceding basis isomorphism. This is the localization mechanism of [lem-weil-proetale-weakly-etale-localization], applied to exactly the source sheafifications, with no replacement root construction.

proof_origin.place: Compatible primitive-root cover: same-universe w-contractible ring extensions, sections of primitive-root and Kummer covers, explicit locally bijective exponentiation maps, diagram naturality and sheafification/restriction. All steps are proved in Lean; no residual obligation.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_compatible_roots_diagram_basis
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime] (hℓ : IsUnit (ℓ : Γ(X, ⊤))) :
    ∃ 𝒰 : Scheme.Cover.{u} Scheme.proetalePrecoverage X, ∀ i : 𝒰.I₀,
      Nonempty
        (tateRootsSystem X ℓ ⋙ upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (𝒰.f i) ≅
        constantTateResidueSystem X ℓ ⋙ upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (𝒰.f i))
